item.title: Bermuda prepares for possible direct hit from Hurricane Igor

item.title: Hurricane Karl hits Mexican coast
item.description: Hurricane Karl made landfall on the Mexican coast ten miles north of Veracruz at 1 p.m. today as a Category three hurricane with 115 mph winds. item.title: Hurricane Igor moves away from Bermuda
item.description: HAMILTON, Bermuda, CMC – A weakening Hurricane Igor is expected to continue moving away from Bermuda on Monday and should begin affecting New Foundland by Tuesday, according to the Miami-based National Hurricane Centre (NHC).
